# GitHub Files

This website contains assignments completed for the CSU 523C course requirements.

## Labs

- [Lab 1](lab-01.qmd)

    - In this lab USGS river gauge data along the Colorado River Basin, United States was compiled and 
      modeled.
    
- [Lab 2](lab-02.qmd)

    - This week's lab focused on displaying U.S. population data based on the proximity the cities are to
      international and national borders.
    
- [Lab 3](lab-03.qmd)

    - This Lab focused on processing large-scale dam inventory data from across the United States. We 
      evaluated different tessellated surfaces to reveal how the data interpretation differed amongst the 
      methods.
      
- [Lab 4](lab-04.qmd)

      - In Lab 4 we analyzed flood data near Palo, Iowa using different data visualization methods.
